headline: KPMG Drops Healthcare Tech Report. The Signal Is What's Missing.
summary: KPMG published two simultaneous healthcare AI frameworks this week: its Global Tech Report 2026 healthcare edition and a separate intelligent healthcare paper. This is a coordinated practice positioning move, not thought leadership for its own sake. Expect KPMG outreach to health system clients using these frameworks as conversation openers in the next 60 days. Separately, Huron's Q3 2026 earnings showed AI-driven services lifting healthcare revenue, and BRG acquired a healthcare startup communications firm. The mid-tier consulting market is moving on healthcare AI faster than most people are tracking.
so_what: KPMG published its Global Tech Report 2026 with a dedicated healthcare section and a separate intelligent healthcare paper. When a Big Four firm drops two simultaneous healthcare AI frameworks in one week, they're positioning for client conversations, not just thought leadership.
